steps.en: Drag the downloaded Cakebrew.app into Applications and open it
steps.zh: 把下载的 Cakebrew.app 拖进应用程序并打开

steps.en: Reads your existing Homebrew installation through its Objective-C wrapper
steps.zh: 通过 Objective-C 封装读取你已装好的 Homebrew

steps.en: Search formulae and press Install, Uninstall or Upgrade
steps.zh: 搜索 formula，点安装、卸载或升级

steps.en: Runs the brew command and refreshes the list in the window
steps.zh: 执行 brew 命令并刷新窗口里的列表

steps.en: Tap or untap a repo, or run cleanup from the tools list
steps.zh: tap 或 untap 仓库，或在工具列表里跑 cleanup

value.en: Formulae, taps and cleanup driven from one window instead of the terminal — on an app with no release since 2021
value.zh: 用窗口而不是终端来管 formula、tap 和 cleanup——但这个应用自 2021 年起没再发版
